verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agent model works via developer checkouts polling for approved tasks and PR review gates (advisory checks, retest via comment), but there is no evidence of a CI/CD-triggered workflow where a build/test failure spawns or invokes an agent to fix it. The CLI's scriptability (usable from cron/agents) and MCP endpoint are generic, not documented as a CI/CD build-failure remediation trigger. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The rationale concedes nothing describes CI/CD integration or fixing broken builds and rests on a CI job 'plausibly' filing a task; the pack's approval gate ('nothing runs until a person approves a contract') further counters automatic CI-triggered fixes. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
